# How Glass Speaks to Light^{™}

From the White House to the Burj Khalifa, from the U.S. to Sweden, Germany, and countries all
throughout the world, our glass plays an integral part in some of the most recognizable structures
ever built.

[ Explore projects ][166]

### Bendheim Glass Systems

Precision-engineered, proven, and easy to specify, our wide range of interior and exterior glass
systems offer flexibility and ease of installation for a variety of applications.

production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protection in the
building sector and industry. Sika has subsidiaries in 103 countries around the world, produces in
over 400 factories, and develops innovative technologies for customers worldwide. In doing so, it
plays a crucial role in enabling the transformation of the construction and transportation
industries toward greater environmental compatibility. In 2025, Sika’s 33,700 employees generated
annual sales of CHF 11.20 billion.

### “Your Dreams,  Our Challenge”

leading solutions company in Glass, Electronics, Chemicals and Ceramics industries. Through world
leading technologies and expertise developed over more than 110 years of technical innovation, we
offer a diverse line-up of products and solutions for customers across more than 30 countries and
areas. In order to further enrich society, the AGC group pushes the limits in the creation of new
standards of value and has made a commitment to positioning mobility related business, electronics
related business and life science related business as our strategic initiatives.

## Commercial

American Insulated Glass offers a complete range of glass solutions designed for exterior and
interior commercial building applications. Certified by the world’s leading manufacturers of
high-performance glass—Cardinal, Guardian, AGC, Vetrotech and Saint Gobain, architects have ease of
access to advanced glazing solutions that support energy efficiency, life-safety and fire-safety
design requirements combined with quality assurance.

## Residential

Certified by the Insulating Glass Certification Council (IGCC) and the Safety Glazing Certification
Council (SGCC), AIG has created an outstanding reputation in the residential and commercial markets
by supplying the most energy efficient coated glass options available in today’s market. The breadth
of our product range, spacer and muntin options—and, service excellence keep us at the forefront of
the residential glazing industry.

## Millwork

Founded on supplying quality glass tempered and insulating glass for millwork windows and doors, AIG
continues to thrive in this market segment by providing intricate and unique options, including
beveled and decorative glass. Our custom fabrication capabilities allow us to accept templates or
DXF files with shapes available beyond the standard range. The millwork industry can rely on
American Insulated Glass.






A.L. Smith Glass was acquired by AIG in December 2019. Originally founded by Alton and Joyce Smith,
A.L. Smith Glass has been serving the glass and glazing industry for nearly five decades—adding
state-of-art technology and expanding its fabricated glass capabilities to meet the growing demand
in the North megalopolis that includes the Washington, D.C. area. [View Press Release][32]



Great Lakes Glass Distributors, is now part of the American Insulated Glass family of businesses.
Located near Detroit, the company is a glass fabricator and wholesale distributor known for its
dedication to serving glazing contractors throughout Michigan, northern Ohio and northwest Indiana,
providing a complete line of flat glass and insulating glass capabilities. AIG is making multiple
equipment upgrades to this facility to position them to more effectively service both commercial and
residential building applications. [View Press Release][33]




Innovative Glass of America (IGA) was acquired by AIG in late 2018. Formerly owned by Louie Dean,
this North Carolina-based glass fabricator and wholesale distributor is well-known to glazing
contractors and architects throughout the Southeast. IGA has been rebranded as American Insulated
Glass and will continue to service customers with an array of flat glass and specialty glazing
solution for commercial and residential building applications. [View Press Release][34]

##### What will the assembled U-value be based on specified glass?

For 1″ insulated glass, the assembled U-value will be approximately 0.4 points higher than the
specified COG U-value. Example: COG U-value of 0.24 = Assembled U-value of 0.28. 

##### How do I specify a FreMarq system?

There are CAD details and guide specifications located on each product page as well as on the
resources page. If you’d like to speak to a sales professional to get you started, call (715)
842-6842 and we would be happy to assist. 

##### What are FreMarq's project limitations?

We have provided products on all-size projects across all industries. We are a custom fabricator and
regularly cut custom dies to fit project needs.

from our award winning IGL Aegis anti-corrosion coating through to our state of the art IGL Titan

family and pets!

# Your reliable glass fabrication supplier

We focus on offering one-stop solutions on glass processing for global OEM/ODM customers.

In order to make precision processing glass, we have equipped with a 45m-long tempering furnace,
Intermac CNC work center, Intermac cutting table, Double edge grinding machine, waterjet, PVB, and
EVA laminating lines. We also have an acid etching line, two silkscreen- printing lines, and 2
mirror lines to meet the all-round needs of customers.

precision and minimum cutting tolerance. Accurate cutting is the priority of all the further glass

Cnc Work Center

grind edges and corners on different kind of glass and mirror. Min workable size is 250*200mm and
max workable size is 3660*2500mm, tolerance +-0.5mm, 1.6mm-19mm thickness.

[Printing Line]
Printing Line

Colorful logo and graphics can be printed on glass and mirror products by our silk screen printing
line and UV-printer. Skilled engineers can give you solutions regarding glass pattern design, and
anti-UV ink.

[Glass Double Edge Grinding Line]
Glass Double Edge Grinding Line

We set up 2 lines of double edging grinding line to combine accuracy and efficiency. Workable on
C-edge and flat-edge, range 65mm-3100mm, matte and polished.

[Glass Tempering Furnace, TamGlass and NorthGlass]
Glass Tempering Furnace, TamGlass and NorthGlass

Glass tempering furnace can produce half tempered glass 1.3mm-19mm, and fully tempered glass
3mm-19mm. Everyday capacity is 5000sqm.

[Waterjet Cutting Line]
Waterjet Cutting Line

Irregular holes and ultra thick glass can not be processed with general cutting table. We set up 3
waterjet cutting lines to make custom glass holes. The advantage is that Waterjet finish does not
need further processing before tempering.

[Acid Etched Glass]
Acid Etched Glass

We have 8 acid reacting pool for matte glass, ag glass, and acid etched glass. The horizontal
producing line max processing size is 2850*4200mm, and vertical pool max glass processing size is
2000*2800.

### **ABOUT US**

**S.K Novel Materials & Technologies (SKNMT) LLP**  is a young and dynamic company and it started
journey from I.I.T. Delhi in 2017. It offer its products and services under **SKNMT** brand. SKNMT
is a leading supplier of best quality** advanced research materials** including wafers, substrates,
sputtering targets, evaporation materials & sources, 2D crystals for exfoliation &
nano-materials and **research lab instruments** including muffle furnaces, multi-zone tubular
furnace, hotplate magnetic stirrer, vacuum oven and hydro-thermal autoclaves. We provide both
standard and custom-made research materials & equipment and solutions to meet customer-specific
requirements. SKNMT has a team of experienced researchers and engineers*. *

SKNMT is committed to supply high quality materials and equipment for research laboratories and

materials and equipment. On the other hand fast after sale service to our valuable customers.

Serving the Commercial and Residential Markets since 1990][31]


## Commercial

American Insulated Glass offers a complete range of glass solutions designed for exterior and
interior commercial building applications. Certified by the world’s leading manufacturers of
high-performance glass—Cardinal, Guardian, AGC, Vetrotech and Saint Gobain, architects have ease of
access to advanced glazing solutions that support energy efficiency, life-safety and fire-safety
design requirements combined with quality assurance.

## Residential

Certified by the Insulating Glass Certification Council (IGCC) and the Safety Glazing Certification
Council (SGCC), AIG has created an outstanding reputation in the residential and commercial markets
by supplying the most energy efficient coated glass options available in today’s market. The breadth
of our product range, spacer and muntin options—and, service excellence keep us at the forefront of
the residential glazing industry.

## Millwork

Founded on supplying quality glass tempered and insulating glass for millwork windows and doors, AIG
continues to thrive in this market segment by providing intricate and unique options, including
beveled and decorative glass. Our custom fabrication capabilities allow us to accept templates or
DXF files with shapes available beyond the standard range. The millwork industry can rely on
American Insulated Glass.






A.L. Smith Glass was acquired by AIG in December 2019. Originally founded by Alton and Joyce Smith,
A.L. Smith Glass has been serving the glass and glazing industry for nearly five decades—adding
state-of-art technology and expanding its fabricated glass capabilities to meet the growing demand
in the North megalopolis that includes the Washington, D.C. area. [View Press Release][32]



Great Lakes Glass Distributors, is now part of the American Insulated Glass family of businesses.
Located near Detroit, the company is a glass fabricator and wholesale distributor known for its
dedication to serving glazing contractors throughout Michigan, northern Ohio and northwest Indiana,
providing a complete line of flat glass and insulating glass capabilities. AIG is making multiple
equipment upgrades to this facility to position them to more effectively service both commercial and
residential building applications. [View Press Release][33]




Innovative Glass of America (IGA) was acquired by AIG in late 2018. Formerly owned by Louie Dean,
this North Carolina-based glass fabricator and wholesale distributor is well-known to glazing
contractors and architects throughout the Southeast. IGA has been rebranded as American Insulated
Glass and will continue to service customers with an array of flat glass and specialty glazing
solution for commercial and residential building applications. [View Press Release][34]

### **ABOUT US**

**S.K Novel Materials & Technologies (SKNMT) LLP**  is a young and dynamic company and it started
journey from I.I.T. Delhi in 2017. It offer its products and services under **SKNMT** brand. SKNMT

sputtering targets, evaporation materials & sources, 2D crystals for exfoliation &
nano-materials and **research lab instruments** including muffle furnaces, multi-zone tubular
furnace, hotplate magnetic stirrer, vacuum oven and hydro-thermal autoclaves. We provide both
standard and custom-made research materials & equipment and solutions to meet customer-specific
requirements. SKNMT has a team of experienced researchers and engineers*. *
